Documents:
[1] Sagarika Ghose: Sagarika Ghose (born 8 November 1964) is an Indian journalist, news anchor and author. She has been a journalist since 1991 and has worked at "The Times Of India", "Outlook" and "The Indian Express". She was the deputy editor and a prime time anchor on the news network CNN-IBN. Ghose has won several awards in journalism and is the author of two novels. She resigned as deputy editor of CNN-IBN in July 2014 after the network was taken over by Reliance Industries. She is now consulting editor at "The Times of India". She is the author of the recently published book, "Indira, India's Most Powerful Prime Minister."

[2] CNN-IBN Indian of the Year: The CNN-News18 Indian of the Year (originally CNN-IBN Indian of the Year) is an award presented annually to various Indians for their work in their respective fields by the Indian media house CNN-News18. The awards are presented in various categories of Politics, Sports, Business, Entertainment, Public Service and Global Indian. It is the brainchild of world-renowned journalists Padmashri Rajdeep Sardesai and Sagarika Ghose.

[3] Sanjeeb Mukherjee: Sanjeeb Mukherjee is an Indian news anchor and journalist, presently the Cricket Editor of CNN-News18 news channel. He has over a decade long experience in the industry having made a mark for himself in investigative journalism.

[4] Rajdeep Sardesai: Rajdeep Sardesai (born 24 May 1965) is an Indian news anchor and author. Sardesai is currently a consulting editor at the India Today group, and hosts India Today Television. He was the Editor-in-Chief of Global Broadcast News, that included CNN-IBN, IBN7 and IBN-Lokmat—which he resigned in July 2014.

[5] Karma Paljor: Karma Paljor is an award-winning Indian journalist and television news anchor. His career as a media professional began in 2001 and since then he's been associated with some famous news channel and last channel he was with is CNN-News18. He has received several awards for his role as a reporter and for his coverage of natural disasters since then.

Question: The CNN-News18 Indian of the Year award was created by Sagarika Ghose and a news anchor born in what year?
content:
Based on the documents, the CNN-News18 Indian of the Year award was created by Sagarika Ghose and Rajdeep Sardesai (document [2]). Rajdeep Sardesai is described as an Indian news anchor and author who was born on 24 May 1965 (document [4]).

ANSWER: 1965
thinking:

From document [2]: "It is the brainchild of world-renowned journalists Padmashri Rajdeep Sardesai and Sagarika Ghose."

So the other creator is Rajdeep Sardesai.

From document [4]: "Rajdeep Sardesai (born 24 May 1965) is an Indian news anchor and author."

So Rajdeep Sardesai was born in 1965.
